_note: FPS's own output, reproduced exactly by prototypes/fps_oracle/. `lines` is the duplicate-expanded cloud FPS writes (a voxel once per dye radius that fits); `unique_voxels` is the volume. `weighted_mean` is the mean of all lines, i.e. density-weighted. p_1bp's cloud ships verbatim as test/input/fps/p_1bp_D.xyz; p66's is 3 MB and is regenerated by the oracle instead.
